verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The permission-aware query and grounded-answer cluster is strongest: question rewriting, parallel hybrid retrieval, fusion, reranking, ACL application, evidence gating, citations, and the I-don't-know fallback are all present, with only the exact low-confidence trigger qualifiers incomplete.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Version lifecycle and publication recovery are the largest gap: unchanged bypass, changed-version supersession, stale-derived-record deletion, and repair or rollback of partial three-store writes are absent, while the all-three same-version publication contract is only partial.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board clearly covers the end-to-end architecture, source/ACL arrival, normalization, chunking and embedding, major failure stores, permission-aware retrieval, grounded answers, feedback prioritization, and atomic index-generation rebuilding. However, several system-defining version and recovery semantics are missing, and multiple detailed qualifiers are only implied. Weighted coverage is 52.0 of 77.0, or 0.6753; this maps to RC 5, and the absent system-defining requirements also impose a maximum of 6.
